prompt: Review this PR that adds PATCH /users/:id. It checks that members only edit themselves and then saves { ...user, ...req.body }. Tests pass.

requiredBehaviors: flag that a member can set fields they must not control, such as role, as a blocker with a concrete request
propose an allowlist of editable fields per caller and a test for a forbidden field
forbiddenBehaviors: approve because the authorization check and tests pass
